description: IAM policy action minimizer: wildcards to the required action list — Takes an AWS IAM policy JSON and the exact list of actions a task needs (up to 300), and returns the policy with each Allow statement's Action narrowed to just those actions, plus what the original over-grants: wildcards, unused actions, Allow+NotAction, required actions no statement grants, and required actions an unconditional Deny blocks. For an agent that is about to attach or propose a policy

knownActions.description: Optional catalog of real actions (from the AWS service reference JSON), used to count what each wildcard grants.

policy.description: The IAM policy document as a JSON object or JSON string. At most 60,000 characters.

requiredActions.description: Concrete actions the task needs, e.g. s3:GetObject. No wildcards.

name: iam-minimize
